note: Benchmark corpus written for this PR. `clean`: ordinary work and personal messages with no intended errors (false-positive check). `errors`: the same messages with common typos and grammar slips injected. `chat`: casual Slack-style messages (lowercase, shorthand, @mentions, URLs, emoji). `spelling_fixes`: the intended word for each misspelling in `errors`, to score the first suggested replacement.
